A.note: A has a complete structure, including purpose, overview, schedule, benefits and sign-up, with a tidy green-and-yellow layout. The date, venue, course length and contact details are all left as placeholders (○), so they must be filled in before use.

B.note: B uses illustrations and a consistent colour scheme for a warm, polished look. It includes real details such as the date (December 5), times, the sign-up deadline and the sign-up method, so it is nearly ready to use. The course is described only in general terms, and the small labels are hard to read.

C.note: C has the most specific content: 2km and 4km courses, a timetable, a 5,000-won fee, a sign-up period and safety rules. The 'program' table on the packing-list slide is out of place, and the QR code links to an example URL that must be replaced.

D.note: D has attractive illustrations and a calm design. Almost all the key information (school name, date, time, place, sign-up details) is left as [placeholders], and much of the body text is too small.
